subject: Engineering Fundamentals
title: The Internet: From ARPANET to Everything
description: A quick win: understand The Internet: From ARPANET to Everything.

hook.text: The first internet message was 'LO'. It was supposed to say 'LOGIN' — but the system crashed.

buildup.text: ARPANET connected four universities in 1969. The goal was to share expensive computers, not cat videos.

discovery.text: Packet switching splits data into pieces that travel different routes and reassemble at the destination.

twist.text: Tim Berners-Lee built the World Wide Web in 1989 — and gave it away for free. He could have been a billionaire.

climax.text: Today, 5 billion people are online. The network designed for four computers connects half the planet.

punchline.text: The first message crashed. Then it connected the world.

quiz.question: What was the first message sent over ARPANET?
options: HELLO — a simple greeting between two universities
LO — the system crashed before finishing LOGIN
